CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.roe_eigenvectors.accepted_type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (x y : CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.E) (n : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  1 < γ →
    CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode x) →
      CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode y) →
        CFDLean.dot n n = 1 →
          (∀ (s : ℝ),
              s = -CFDLean.Roe.soundSpeed γ x y ∨ s = CFDLean.Roe.soundSpeed γ x y →
                (CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix γ x y n)
                    (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.acoustic (CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity x y) (CFDLean.Roe.averageEnthalpy γ x y)
                      n s) =
                  (CFDLean.dot (CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity x y) n + s) •
                    CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.acoustic (CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity x y) (CFDLean.Roe.averageEnthalpy γ x y)
                      n s) ∧
            (CFDLean.Roe.roeMatrix γ x y n) (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.contact (CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity x y)) =
                CFDLean.dot (CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity x y) n •
                  CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.contact (CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity x y) ∧
              ∀ (t : CFDLean.Vector 3),
                CFDLean.dot t n = 0 →
